title: Forza Horizon 6 PlayStation 5 çıkış tarihi ertelendi
summary: Playground Games'in yarış oyunu Forza Horizon 6'nın PlayStation 5 sürümü 2027 yılına ertelendi. Oyunun Ocak ayında çıkması bekleniyor.
body:
Polygon'un aktardığına göre, PlayStation 5 oyuncularının merakla beklediği Forza Horizon 6 çıkış tarihi ertelendi. Daha önce 2026 yılı içerisinde geleceği duyurulan oyunun Sony Interactive Entertainment tarafından yapılan açıklamaya göre **26 Ocak 2027** tarihinde piyasaya çıkacağı kesinleşti. Geliştirici stüdyo Playground Games daha önce erteleme iddialarını yalanlamış ve içerik güncellemeleri hakkındaki iletişim eksikliği nedeniyle özür dilemişti.

## Oyunun satış başarıları ve Xbox'ın stratejisi

Mayıs ayında Xbox Series X ve Windows PC için satışa sunulan yapım, eleştirmenlerden olumlu notlar almıştı. Alinea Analytics tarafından hazırlanan bir rapora göre, oyun henüz PlayStation platformuna gelmeden **7,4 milyondan fazla** kopya satmayı başardı ve yaklaşık 534,3 milyon dolar gelir elde etti. Yaşanan bu ertelemenin arkasında, zor günler geçiren Xbox division bünyesindeki stratejik değişikliklerin ve yeniden yapılanma sürecinin yer aldığı ifade ediliyor.

**Neden önemli?** Oyun serisinin PlayStation pazarındaki büyük popülaritesi göz önüne alındığında, Microsoft'un gelecekteki oyunlarını rakip platformlara taşıyıp taşımayacağı sektörel açıdan yakından takip ediliyor.

source_texts.title: All treasure car locations in Forza Horizon 6
source_texts.summary: Treasure cars are hidden around the Forza Horizon 6 map. Here's where to find every treasure car, along with their vehicle stats.
source_texts.text:
Treasure cars are like buried treasure in Forza Horizon 6. They're iconic cars that are hiding about, but also free for the taking.
However, like real buried treasure, they're almost impossible to find if you don't know where to look. If you drive within the vicinity of a treasure car, you'll be given a hint regarding its location, but the hint can be very difficult to use if you don't know your way around the map. Though, you shouldn't let that you, as treasure cars can be very helpful if you're just starting out.
Finding these cars can be quite daunting, as the Forza Horizon 6 map is huge. To prevent you from getting lost, here's where to find every treasure car in Forza Horizon 6.
Update (Oct. 8): We've updated this guide with the new treasure car.
All treasure car locations in Forza Horizon 6
You can find a total of 10 treasure cars scattered throughout the game's regions. You can obtain the information you need to find these cars by checking the "Treasure Cars" list in the "Cars" menu. A treasure car's name and the hint about its location only become available after you drive near it. Once Mei tells you over the radio about a rumor surrounding an abandoned car, its details will be added to the list.
After you find a treasure car, you simply need to approach it and press the "collect" command. A short cutscene will play, after which you will have the option to either drive it or store the car in your garage.
Below, you'll find a list of every treasure car in Forza Horizon 6:
- 1970 Citroën 2CV
- 1991 Nissan Figaro
- 1969 Dodge Charger R/T
- 1985 Mazda RX-7 GSL-SE
- 1987 Porsche 959
- 1981 BMW M1
- 1995 Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution 3 GSR
- 1974 Lancia Stratos HF Stradale
- 2005 Ford GT
- 1985 Nissan Safari Turbo
For more information on where to find each treasure car, check out the sections below.
1970 Citroën 2CV
- Region: Minamino
- Hint: "This abandoned classic overlooks the Irabuohashi Bridge."
You can find the Irabuohashi Bridge on the northeast side of the Minamino region, near the border of Hokubo region. To reach the exact location, you must use a long off-road path southwest of the bridge, and east of Shirakawa-go. Once you get to the highest spot, leave the road for a lookout area, where you will find this car.
1991 Nissan Figaro
- Region: Tokyo City
- Hint: "A classic Nissan Figaro, forgotten in one of the city's car parks near the iconic Rainbow Bridge."
To find the Figaro, you need to head south of the Tokyo City region. Once you're facing the shore, you should look for the Rainbow Bridge, which is the one on the left side of the map that connects Tokyo City to a small island where the Drift Club Japan story is located. After locating the bridge, drive east from it to find the small parking lot with the Figaro awaiting you.
1969 Dodge Charger R/T
- Region: Minamino
- Hint: "This American classic has been spotted out the back of the Minamino region's golf course clubhouse."
The golf course is located right in the middle of the Minamino region. If you take the Yuji's Auto as a reference point, travel northeast to find the clubhouse. The car is hidden behind a 365 convenience store in front of the golf course. Go around the convenience store to find the Dodge Charger R/T behind it.
1985 Mazda RX-7 GSL-SE
- Region: Ohtani
- Hint: "This RX-7 has been spotted near some radio towers in the Ohtani region. "
When heading east from the Shimanoyama to the Ohtani region, follow an off-road trail that leads you to red radio towers. Break the fence and approach the buildings near the radio towers. On the southeast side, below one of the radio towers, you will find this car.
1987 Porsche 959
- Region: Shimanoyama
- Hint: "Spotted outside a convenience store in the Shimanoyama region is a Porsche 959 in need of a loving new owner."
The Porsche 959 is parked outside a convenience store in the post town of Narai-juku. To reach it, you must go northwest of the stadium in the Shimanoyama region and follow the road until you reach a town. Continue east to find a large parking lot, from where you access the convenience store. In front of the entrance, you will find this Porsche.
1981 BMW M1
- Region: Hokubu
- Hint: "This classic BMW M1 has been left under one of the railway bridges in the Hokubu region."
You will find the BMW M1 under the railway bridge on the northern side of Hokubu, close to the Takashiro region border. Look for the gray line, which is the railyway, that runs through the farm fields, and drive beneath it.
1995 Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution 3 GSR
- Region: Takashiro
- Hint: "An abandoned Lancer has been spotted below a waterfall in the Takashiro region, near one of the temples."
The Lancer Evolution 3 GSR is located at the far western end of Takashiro. As you travel west, take a road beside a small torii, a traditional Japanese gate. Follow the road until you find an exit on the right side of the road leading to a waterfall. Drive down the path to locate this car.
1974 Lancia Stratos HF Stradale
- Region: Sotoyama
- Hint: "A legendary Lancia Stratos has been spotted abandoned near Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route in the Sotoyama region."
The Lancia Stratos is located beside a building west of the Hakusan Mountain Lodge. Starting from the lodge on the eastern side, take the road that crosses the region heading west. Eventually, you will spot a large light brown building on the right side of the road. The Stratos is parked just outside the building.
2005 Ford GT
- Region: Nangan
- Hint: "Spotted down one of the Nangan region's coastal trails, this Ford GT is in need of some TLC."
You can find the GT Ford by traveling to the far southeastern side of Nangan. Follow the road that takes you close to the coast. Once you reach the point closest to the shore, you will find a small parking area with a yellow sign. Take one of the two paths in this area and continue heading east to find the car parked at the lookout point.
1985 Nissan Safari Turbo
- Region: Ito
- Hint: "Perfect for the Ito region's rough terrain, this Nissan Safari has been left to weather the elements near the Wind Farm."
The wind farm, as described in the hint, is on the northeast side of Ito. Once you spot one of the wind turbines, you should follow the road heading north to eventually reach the farm. Along one of the curves, you will find the Safari Turbo parked beside the base of a wind turbine.

source_texts.title: 'Forza Horizon 6' Officially Delayed to 2027 on PS5
source_texts.summary: 'Forza Horizon 6' has been officially delayed to January 2027 on PlayStation 5, Sony and Playground Games have confirmed.
source_texts.text:
Forza Horizon 6 is one of the best and most popular games of the year. Developer Playground Games released its latest racing game on Xbox and PC in May to strong critical and commercial reception. After months of rumors, we finally have official confirmation that Forza Horizon 6 has been delayed on PlayStation 5 to 2027. Playground Games' racing game is now set for a January release on PS5. It was previously scheduled for sometime in 2026.
The reveal comes shortly after Forza Horizon 6 developer Playground Games denied that the port was being delayed. The studio recently apologized on X for its lack of communication about content updates and fixes.
On Thursday, Sony Interactive Entertainment confirmed a Jan. 26, 2027 release date for Forza Horizon 6.
Why is this a big deal?
The Forza Horizon series has quietly become one of the best-selling game franchises in recent memory. A recent report by Alinea Analytics estimated that even before launching on PlayStation, Forza Horizon 6 has already sold more than 7.4 million copies and generated an estimated $534.3 million in revenue. The game was released on Windows PC and Xbox Series X on May 19 to stellar reviews.
In 2021, Microsoft said that Forza Horizon 5 had the biggest launch in Xbox history, with more than 10 million players in its first week. The Microsoft-published game has been similarly successful on PS5, selling over five million copies in 2025 when it was released on the platform years later.
While it’s clear promised. When Playground Games originally announced Forza Horizon 6's release date, it said the PS5 version would launch later in 2026.
The lack of communication around the port coincided with the struggling Xbox division’s major “reset,” which has led to thousands of job cuts and the sale of several studios. As part of Xbox’s shift, the company seems to be de-prioritizing launching its games on PlayStation. Xbox recently released Halo: Campaign Evolved on PlayStation and reportedly planned to do the same with Gears of War: E-Day, but allegedly canceled the port behind closed doors. Given the Forza Horizon series’ massive popularity on PlayStation, it remains to be seen whether Xbox will continue bringing future series entries to this rival’s system.
